label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf dissolution
items.text: LIV Golf is folding and Bryson DeChambeau is still owed $5.77 million; he has been offered 2027 playing privileges by the DP World Tour as a route back to PGA Tour eligibility.

items.headline: Rahm leads Abu Dhabi
items.text: Jon Rahm shot a 6-under 66 on Saturday to lead the Abu Dhabi Championship at 18-under 198, one stroke ahead of Tyrrell Hatton and Francesco Laporta.

items.headline: McIlroy trails by two
items.text: Rory McIlroy, after eight birdies and a double-bogey on the 10th, sits two shots behind Jon Rahm going into the final round at the Abu Dhabi Championship.
